leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips were clear preparations, but felt less engaging than fitting the parts.

arbitrary.text: The fictional lift tile's power is explicitly invented, so its operation has no physical explanation here; seating it in the cradle still had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I might continue to see what the whale carrier does, but this chapter's mostly single-option fittings offered limited decisions.
